page.overview:
Who is Don Beauman?

Donald Beauman was a British Formula 1 driver, who competed in a single Formula One Championship race in 1954. He drove a Connaught A, entered by Sir Jeremy Boles, in the 1954 British Grand Prix. He qualified 17th on the grid, finishing 11th.

He also competed in numerous Non-Championship races in 1954, taking a number of podiums. He continued his career into 1955, but was killed in a sportscar race before he could reappear in the championship.
